body: On purpose, from the June desktop fixes: src/css/custom.css caps the page text at 680px (about 70 characters a line) on every page of the site. It is meant to let code blocks, tables and pictures use the full width, but it doesn't, so they stop at 680px too. Because the fix changes every page on the site, I've asked in the chat which way you want it.
